{{Quote|I apologize for reneging on our deal, but I have orders. You understand. I recommend you surrender.|Watcher One|<ref name="The Rescue" />}}
In [[3643 BBY]], during the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Angral]]'s [[Desolator crisis|campaign of vengeance]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] for the [[Death/Legends|death]] of his [[Gender/Legends|son]], [[Tarnis (Sith Lord)|Tarnis]], a [[Hero of Tython|young Jedi Knight]] '''raided''' the [[Imperial Intelligence Outpost]] in the depths of the ruined [[Transport Station 5]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. The [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] and a companion sought to rescue the Republic [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Nasan Godera]], who had been captured by [[Watcher One]], an agent of [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]]. The duo were too late to prevent Watcher One from using a truth serum on Godera to interrogate him about his work on [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapons]], and Angral ordered the [[operative]] to capture the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]&mdash;the same Jedi who was responsible for Tarnis's [[Duel in the Jedi Temple ruins|death]]. Watcher One was defeated, however, and the Knight allowed the man to depart Taris and go into hiding, while the Jedi returned Godera to Republic custody.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|We could continue this chase forever&mdash;but what a waste of resources. I suggest a compromise. Give me time to administer truth serum to Doctor Godera. Once he reveals his secrets, he's yours. We'll both have what we want.|Watcher One|<ref name="A More Immediate Concern" />}}
In [[3643 BBY]], during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Angral]] declared [[Desolator crisis|war]] on the Republic when his [[Gender/Legends|son]], [[Tarnis (Sith Lord)|Tarnis]], was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by a [[Hero of Tython|young Jedi Knight]]. Seizing control of several Republic [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapons]],<ref name="Race to the Ruins">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Race to the Ruins|Coruscant}}</ref> Angral also dispatched [[Watcher One]], a high-ranking [[operative]] of the [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Empire's intelligence organization]], with a complement of [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] personnel to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] to capture the former Republic [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Nasan Godera]]. However, the same [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who had [[Duel in the Jedi Temple ruins|killed]] Tarnis was sent by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Var Suthra]] to locate Godera as well.<ref name="The Architect">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|The Architect of Annihilation|Taris}}</ref>

{{GameLS}}
Watcher One managed to stay one step ahead of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and escaped with Godera, and, in order to secure [[Time/Legends|time]] to interrogate the scientist, he contacted the Jedi and made a deal: In exchange for [[Time/Legends|time]], the operative revealed the presence of a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Rora Seake|assassin]] who was about to attack a nearby [[Lake Brell colony|colony]], and he promised to give Godera to the Jedi once his mission was complete. The Knight [[Duel in the Lake Brell colony bunker|prevented]] the [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] from wiping out the colony, meanwhile, Watcher One&mdash;who had returned to the [[Imperial Intelligence Outpost]] in the depths of a ruined complex known as [[Transport Station 5]]&mdash;injected Godera with a truth serum and questioned him on his knowledge of superweapon design.<ref name="A More Immediate Concern" />
{{Endgame}}

==The raid==
{{Quote|You&hellip; compromised? With the Jedi vermin who killed my son?|Darth Angral, to Watcher One|<ref name="The Rescue" />}}
After securing the colony, the Knight and a companion followed the coordinates for Godera's bioscan that the doctor's [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[RE-M0]] had given them, and they fought through the hostile [[rakghoul]] creatures that inhabited Transport Station 5 as they headed into the ruins. Unaware of the Knight's deal with Watcher One, the dozen Imperial operatives stationed at the facility attacked the Jedi upon sight. The Knight and the Jedi's companion dispatched the dozen Imperial [[Sniper/Legends|snipers]] and [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] before heading into the outpost's main chamber, where Watcher One was reporting success to Angral via a [[Holotransmitter/Legends|holotransmission]]. Angral ordered Watcher One to bring Godera to the Empire's [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], but when the Knight arrived, the Sith was enraged to learn that Watcher One had compromised with the Jedi. The furious Sith ordered Watcher One to capture the Jedi before ending the transmission, and the operative apologized to the Jedi for betraying their agreement before drawing his [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]. In the resultant battle, Watcher One was supported by two Imperial operatives, but they were eventually defeated by the Knight and the Jedi's companion; while his subordinates were killed, Watcher One was only injured.<ref name="The Rescue" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Angral will kill you for failing. You can't return to the Empire. Go&mdash;find a new life in the Republic. You may discover we're not the enemy you think.''"<br />"''What? I&hellip; only a fool would question such a generous offer. I thank you. Perhaps our paths will cross again. Farewell, Jedi.|The Knight and Watcher One|<ref name="The Rescue" />}}
{{GameLS}}
Stumbling backward, Watcher One questioned his opponent as to what would happen next. Recognizing that he was a man of honor, the Knight allowed Watcher One to depart and find a new life away from the Empire.<ref name="The Rescue" />
{{Endgame}}

The Knight then released Doctor Godera from his restraints and returned the scientist to the Republic settlement of [[Olaris]], where [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Fau-Kes]] of the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]]&mdash;the Republic's intelligence agency&mdash;had returned after his team failed to make contact with the Knight. At General Suthra's request, Fau-Kes took Godera to the Republic capital of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]],<ref name="The Rescue" /> and the Knight's crew headed to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] to secure the Republic's stolen [[Power Guard Enhancement System|Power Guard Project]].<ref name="The Search for Agent Galen" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|You'll get no mercy from me.''"<br />"''I asked for none. Do as you must.|The Knight and Watcher One|<ref name="The Rescue" />}}
The raid on the Imperial Intelligence Outpost first appeared in the Jedi Knight-class mission "The Rescue" in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark-side]] players will be tasked with retrieving [[Jedi Covenant]] artifacts, while [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light-side]] players are sent to stop an assassin; players can also refuse Watcher One's offer and proceed straight to "The Rescue." After defeating Watcher One, players are presented with a choice: They can kill him for dark-side points, attempt to capture him and fail, or allow him to leave for light-side points. As the Knight is a Republic class and therefore is assumed to choose only light-side alignment options,<ref name="The Rescue" /> this article assumes that the Jedi Knight went after the assassin and allowed Watcher One to leave.
